text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I entered the trainer's room—
for some reason, Matikanefukukitaru was lying in wait.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. My singing brings good fortune.
Or so the divine oracle proclaimed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, right now I'm the strolling guitarist, Lucky Fukukita...
Just give me a request and I'll sing anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, that is not in my repertoire!
Instead, please listen to—
"Good Fortune Blues of the Stray Cloud"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaa~, clouds drift by and the sun sets down,
look up at the sky and see a lucky star...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Matikanefukukitaru sang her
mysterious original fortune-bringing song and left. After that—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The day after I listened to Fukukitaru's song,
I got a letter from Mommy and Daddy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When Maya listened to Fukukitaru-san's song,
I pulled off 10 winks in a row!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...The side dish at my regular diner changed from broccoli to potatoes.
...Hmph, that's much more manageable.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't treat that as good luck!
Eat it whether it's broccoli or potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Another's happiness is one's own happiness.
Sow fortune upon those around you. Then comes happiness."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just as the oracle said, I shall keep scattering
blessings all over the world!
Now then, for today I'll wrap up around—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fuu-fuhun♪ The world, that is~,
THE WORLD~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmh?! Th-This guitar sound is...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...So you've arrived, the strolling Lucky Fukukita.
I'm sorry to say, but the one singing here today is me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After all, your song power is still amateur.
Only the song of Pearl the Worldwide
can bring true power to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-My singing has pro-level lucky power too!
The oracle clearly said—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Saying that makes you
so you tail snake,
straight-up all head and no tail, a half-baked rookie, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Kh, lucky, okki, super happy♪
Nothing to lose with a lucky song, yeah♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's come to this: a music battle!
Let us settle whose song power is superior~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Kh?! Hey, what's going on?!
This guitar sound is so upbeat!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like something's happening outside!
Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bonds connecting with the swirling world♪
Yes, just like stirring up natto♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Kh, a natto song disguised as a world song?!
Then I'll unleash my new song!
"Lucky Shining Star"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lucky lucky lucky meteor♪
To the earth and to the sea, let luck rain down upon us~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Kh, summoning a phantom spotlight
purely through vibes alone?!
Not bad...! But I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Neither Giving an Inch
text_block_list.text: ——YEEEEAAAAAHHHH——!!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Sh-She's strong!
As expected of Pearl-san...! Wait, no,
Pearl the World Tour, was it...?!

text_block_list.name: Excited Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! Let us hear more!
More of your passion!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Kh?! Wh-When did so many
people gather here?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Looks like they felt our power waves and gathered around.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The power held in song multiplies when our passions clash against one another... In other words, we can deliver even more power to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
P-Pearl-san... Don't tell me...
Provoking me was your goal from the very beginning...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, talk later. Everyone is waiting
for our song power...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
…………! Understood!
My—our live performance is only just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone!
Our duet, "Lucky World Stream"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... after that live performance which was
legendary in more ways than one, this spot earned
fame as one of the Academy's premier power spots.
